title: Fix data-actions eval identity-key mismatch (red CI since 998fb12)

comments.author: os
comments.text: Root cause: tests/eval/layers/data-actions/adapter.ts reused the components-layer componentIdentity(), which PR #68 (81ad021) switched to asset:<subtype>. Data-action gold keys are matched literally (resolveDataActionIdentity + sameEntityIdentity), and the documented schema is ${type}:${name}. So ts-pg-store, tf-rds-store, tf-s3-store, java-jdbc-store, dotnet-npgsql-store and java-jpa-store could never pair; the suite has been red since the two branches merged in 998fb12. Fix: data-actions adapter now keys findings by type:name (aligned with data-flow endpoints). Corpus correction: ruby-postgres-store subject.key asset:database -> asset:ruby basic (was written in scanner subtype form; subject.name already 'Ruby Basic').

comments.author: os
comments.text: Landed on main via PR #86 (merge commit c6baf2c). CI test job green for the first time since 3cb99b5.
